name: @tetherto/mdk
description: MDK umbrella repository - root orchestrator. Every publishable backend package (backend/core/*, backend/plugins/*, backend/workers/**, backend/tests/*), the standalone packages/* tools, and examples/{backend,full-site,mvp-site} are members of the root npm workspace below, so a single root install hoists and links them all. The UI toolkit (ui/) stays a separate Turborepo-driven workspace with its own lockfile; root scripts forward to it by prefix.
author: Tether

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:ui && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ui && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:ui && npm run lint:fix --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:ui && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.clean: npm run clean:ui && npm run clean --workspaces --if-present
